lines.en: And so another day of actually working hard at the job I actually care about comes to an end.
I say that almost unironically, as I actually did contribute in some form to the greater good after the last bell rang today.

With Imani and Makoto busy at swim club and the club that I'm meant to advise being mostly fine without any form of supervision, there was no one left to grade the papers my subordinates assigned but me.
Needless to say, everyone received an A+ regardless of whether or not they deserved one and now my wrist hurts from having to write and circle that twenty times.
So, what better place to go from here than a location where everyone else’s wrists hurt as well?
See: the archery range. Or, as I like to refer to it — probably the only club that actually does club stuff instead of just fucking around.
You’ll have to peer past the soul (and cock)-sucking entity in front of you to see it, but I can assure you it is there.
And that it is filled with girls who are unintentionally training themselves to become better at giving me handjobs one day.
: Hey. You haven’t gone home already?
: The one speaking to me now is already good at giving handjobs. But I’m looking forward to seeing how much she improves as the days go by.
: Thanks! Though, I think you might have accidentally said that out loud instead of keeping it to yourself.
: No, I just knew there wasn’t a need to keep it inside anymore as having my innermost thoughts heard by you won’t really change the way either one of us thinks.
: That’s fair. And if it gets you to say nice things about me more often, I’m totally cool with it.
: What are you doing over here? You know Miss Watabe doesn’t like you interrupting practice.
: I’m pretty sure she doesn’t like you leaving in the middle of it either. It looks like everyone else is still out there.
: Yeah...I’m kind of bailing while she’s not paying attention to me. I wasn’t feeling it today.
: Don’t tell me you’re already giving up on this club too?
: I’m not “giving up.” My relationship with kyudo is totally different from my relationship with soccer since this is something I actually chose and didn’t just...get sucked into.
: Why leave then? What aren’t you feeling?
: Uhh...good enough, I guess?
: So it’s the same thing as soccer, just in a slightly different way.
: It’s still different. This is just me getting in my own head.
: That’s the thing with kyudo, though. It’s like 80%% mental and 20%% physical. Even super old people can be really good at it since the mechanics aren’t that demanding.
: So basically, you’re even more screwed than you were in soccer.
: Nuh-uh. Why would I be screwed? All I have to do is just convince myself I’m better than I actually am and I’ve been doing that in pretty much every area of my life for as long as I’ve been alive.
: Like how you still won’t admit you’re actually in love with me.
: Exactly! See? You get it.
: Cool, so I’ll just take that as your admission and we can move onto dating for real.
: Cool! Sounds good.
: That was a joke, Kirin.
: So was mine. I don’t actually love you. I just want you to think I love you since holding your hand the other night felt kind of nice.
: Also, Karin saw us kiss. Whoops.
: Wait...she did?
: No. I just wanted to see what kind of face you’d make. And judging by the one I got, I think it’s safe to say you want to fuck my sister.
: I think it’s safe to say you already knew I wanted to fuck your sister.
: Yeah, but now I really know.
: What’s getting into you, Kirin? I’m not going to stop you from leaving, but I’d at least like to know what’s going on.
: Kind of like how I would have liked to know what was going on while you were fingering Miku?
: Exactly like that. You are being given an opportunity right now to prove how much better than me you are at something. And that’s like, your whole thing.
: Hah...fine.
: It’s Uta. She’s too good already.
: I thought joining a club like this would be the best way to sort of...get ahead of everybody else. I thought I’d finally get to be the good one if I put in the work.
: Last thing I expected was for someone to have experience already. It’s fucking kyudo, not soccer.
: I swear, it’s like every single club has some sort of prodigy in it.
: Not the swim club. They-
: Karin’s in the swim club.
: Oh. Yeah.
: Well, Karin’s just good at everything, so...
: Yeah...you don’t have to remind me.
: That’s really all it is, though. I was gonna go home and watch some videos to study that way, but...
: Do you maybe wanna...hang out for a little while instead?
: Like...in a...non-sexual way or...something?...
: Let me feel your forehead. I think you’re sick.
: It’s not like that! We just...don’t always have to do that stuff, you know?!
: How hard is it for you to say all of this right now?
: You have no fucking idea. But I’m serious. Let’s, like...go bowling. Or...go to the arcade or something. Anywhere with air conditioning is fine, really. I just don’t want to be outside.
: Don’t you have other friends for stuff like that? I’m the sex guy, remember? That’s the whole point of our relationship.
: Oh...yeah. I guess I could...call Noriko or-
: Kirin, I’m joking.
: You are?!
: I mean...uhh...you are?
: Were those just stars-
: No. Anyway, arcade? Let’s go to the arcade. I like the arcade.
: The arcade is really cool. It’s a place where all kinds of people who aren’t even dating go to hang out.
: Which doesn’t mean that people who are dating aren’t allowed there, but- hey. What are you just standing there for? We’re going to the arcade.
: You’re really funny when you try to act like a normal girl, Kirin.
: I’m...plenty normal when I want to be! It’s your fault you’re only just seeing that now!
Thanks to the location of the archery range being a bit of a walk from the main building and clubs still ongoing, we manage to make it off of school grounds without bumping into anyone else.
Well, anyone else we know at least. There are plenty of other girls who see us together and, while Kirin pretends to know who some of them are, I’m almost certain it’s a bluff.
It’s pretty clear at this point that she doesn’t have any friends outside of the class and, if she does, I’m sure it’s all on a superficial basis.
Plus, I’m not too worried about what anyone will think at this point since I leave school with Ami and the others all the time and no one’s said anything yet.
There’s also the fact that arcades are full of teenagers after school lets out, and it was obvious from the get-go that we’d be trying to blend in with them.
After Kirin drops her stuff off in a nearby coin-locker, we make our way into a small, unfamiliar arcade that is, expectedly, filled with other girls from the school.
Some of them look at me, probably because I have a penis, but it’s never for more than a few seconds before they carry on with their business.
Meanwhile, Kirin spends at least 2,000 yen trying to pull a blue turtle out of a glass box.
: Fuck!
: Wow, Kirin. This sure is fun.

: For your information, it wasn’t my intention to repeatedly fail. I’m normally pretty good at these types of games. But at this point, Sensei, I have a vendetta and we can not leave until the Squirtle is mine.
: That is not a good name for whatever that thing is.
: You know what fucking Pokemon are. Stop pretending you were born in like...the mid-Showa period. It’s weird and you’re cool enough without acting all oblivious and shit.
: No one can ever be cool enough, Kirin. But thank you for acknowledging my mysterious air of...mystery.
: Stop cherry-picking the good things out of my insults and just help me already.
: How? Do you want me to turn this into a scene from a rom-com and grip the joystick with you? Move in for a kiss as we pull a weird blue turtle out of a machine?
: What kind of rom-coms are you watching?
: None. I’ve already made it apparent today that I’m too cool for them.
: I just wanted you to stand on the other side of the machine and check my angles, not kiss me in front of like, twenty other girls.
: You want to do that, go for it. It’s your death sentence. Not like I have anything to lose from kissing a teacher.
: Except, you know, the respect of your classmates and whatever sort of reputation you’ve built for yourself.
: Woo boy. Reputation and respect. Yippee.
: You want to know what my reputation is, Sensei? It’s “Karin’s sister.” If anything, making out with a teacher in broad daylight would help put me on the map.
: It would help put me in jail.
: As long as I get my Squirtle, I don’t really care.
: You’d have much more success in that regard if we were in my bedroom.
: Was that...supposed to be a squirting joke? I don't even do that.
: Cool joke though, right?
: Yeah, Sensei. Super-
: FUCK!
: Kirin? Is that you?
: Heh?
: What happened? Aren’t you supposed to be at archery club?
: Uhh...aren’t you supposed to be at swim club?
: It was cancelled after Ayane accidentally killed the janitor. We have the rest of the day off now.
: How does she keep doing that and why isn’t anyone suspicious of it?
: Ah! Sensei! Hi! I’m Karin! It’s nice to meet you!
: Again!
: Kirin, take over. I messed up.
: How are you still this nervous around him? Haven’t you two, like, literally gone on a date together?
: She wasn’t much better during that.
: She was adorable, though. But Karin is always adorable, so-
: And down she goes.
: I’m okay! Don’t mind me!
: Yeah, I had a feeling that was going to happen.
: Haha! Floors! Am I right?!
: You need, like...serious, psychiatric help.
: Oh...Sensei...
: You’re here too...
: What’s up with that reaction?
: What reaction? I’m just...happy you two are...
: Uhh...
: A-Anyway! Is everything...you know...working out over there? In your new club?
: Because it’s a little lonely not having you around anymore and...if you ever want to maybe, like...spend more time together...
: Things are fine. I’m just taking a little time off. I’ve been there way more than the other girls lately and Miss Watabe said I should rest my wrist for a little while so I don’t mess it up.
Kirin lied as naturally as she breathed.
: Really?! That’s great!
: I was so worried you wouldn’t fit in there since you’ve always been with Miku and me. But to hear that everything is going well is-
: Yup. All good. Don’t need to be checked up on. Thanks, Sis.
: Okay...well, I...made plans with a friend, so...I’ll leave you alone now.
: Are you coming home for dinner? You don’t have to if you don’t want to, it’s just...it’s my turn and...I want to...know how much to make...
: Uhhh, not sure. You can make some for me and I’ll just reheat it if I swing by later.
: Okay...
: Guess I’ll just...see you later then.
: Yup. See you.
Karin leaves without saying goodbye to me, but I’m not about to berate her for it when Kirin, as always, is basically the one who forced her away.
: Why not go hang out with her instead?
: Because we’re hanging out. She said she made plans with a friend anyway. I’d just be getting in the way.
: I think Karin would be more than happy to have you tag along.
: That’s nice. But it doesn’t change the fact that I’d rather be with you.
: Why though? You can be with me whenever you want.
: No. I can be with Karin whenever I want. Getting to spend time with you after school is like winning the lottery. Obviously I’m gonna cash in.
: Karin could be, like...delivering a baby or pulling a cat out of a tree and she’d immediately stop doing either of those things if I asked her to come hang out with me.
: Actually, she’d probably finish them first because she’s Karin and she’s fucking perfect and good at everything and wholesome and everyone likes her.
: But, my inferiority complex aside, I can’t do that with you. Your time is spread too thin between all of the other girls who want your fat dick inside of them.
: Which isn’t to say that’s all I want, of course. It’s just...
: Well, you said it yourself the other night.
: “I’m not enough for you.”
: So, like...it got me thinking...how do I become enough?
: It’s gotta be this, right? Spending time together and seeing if we’re compatible in ways where we keep our clothes on instead of just resorting to sex.
: Kirin, are you growing?
: Am I? I thought I stopped.
: No, as a person.
: Oh. Maybe. I don’t know.
: I’m trying not to think too much about it because that’s the same exact problem I’m having with kyudo.
: I just want to hold your hand more.
: And the thought of other girls holding your hand is starting to piss me off.
: But...the thought of me fucking them, isn’t?
: Weirdly enough, the hand thing pisses me off more.
: They both kinda suck, though. But until I’m-
: Stop groping yourself. It’s getting distracting.
: But until I’m “enough” for you, there’s not really anything I can do about that.
: You were right. I’m not as okay with sharing you as I thought I was. I was just telling myself that.
: It’s...really surprising to have to hear you admit that here and now of all times and places.
: I’m surprised too. None of this would have happened if you didn’t show up at my club today. Way to go and ruin my life, Sensei. You know I have feelings now.
: I’ve always known that, Kirin. But, just to set the record straight, you’re the one who’s ruining my life now.
: I’m not at all surprised to hear that, but please tell me why.
: It’s just going to be a lot harder to hurt your feelings now that you’re acknowledging them.
: Is running away still on the table?
: It never was.
: Can it be on the table? Because starting over as a brand new person sounds like...the ultimate blessing right now.
: Especially since I have no clue how I’d ever face Noriko if I ascended from the sex-friend category into...whatever category she’s in.
: Let’s...go on a few more dates first before we start categorizing what we are now.
: Dates?...
: Was this a date?
: I...think so?
: What the fuck? I didn’t even get to dress up for it.
: Now we have to go on another one. It’s literally the only option.
: Well...what are you doing tomorrow night?
: Heh...
: Sounds like I’m getting dressed up...
Kirin’s affection has increased to [kirin_love]!
I make it back to my room after another eventful day.
And I worry about how much my life is about to change.
That seems to be all that’s happening lately.
